question: What did Darius say would happen to anyone who changed his edict?
options: They would be sent to Babylon
They would lose all their money
A beam would be pulled from their house and they would be impaled on it
They would be thrown into a lions' den
explanation: Darius decreed that if anyone changed the edict, a beam was to be pulled from their house and they were to be impaled on it, and their house made a pile of rubble.
